note: Only decreases. For each plugin with a registered stylesheet, the rule blocks of its own namespace that the shared stylesheets still hold: the first slice's splitter finds the shared part, then a second pass counts every rule in it that names the plugin, without discounting stylesheetShared (declaring a class shared cannot hide a rule, and a frame does not make the number zero). stylesheetPrefixes are remembered per plugin and may only be added; the measurement uses the reference/current/build prefix union only for counting the remainder, after splitting by current declarations. Goals counts only GOALS_DOCUMENT_STYLES, TRASH_GOAL_STYLES and PLANNING_SETTINGS_STYLES. Measured from the build by scripts/gates/plugin-styles.mjs; lower it with `node scripts/gates/plugin-styles.mjs --update --base origin/main` in the PR that moves rules out. CI compares this file with the merge-base's copy, so raising a number or adding a plugin here is refused.
